notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.westwing.it/robots.txt) checked first - User-agent:* disallows /all-products, /p/s/*, /customer*, *--*, /*?*q=*, /sso/*, /c/*, /products/*, /collections/*, /api/*; the ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai section (grouped with GPTBot/PerplexityBot/etc.) carries the identical disallow list plus an explicit Allow: /llms.txt - no full-site block. All URLs used in this extraction are plain top-level vanity slugs (e.g. /biancheria-letto/, /mobili-accessori-contenitori/, /tappeti-in-lana/) which are not covered by any Disallow rule, so tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (Python requests with a Chrome UA) was used exclusively for the whole run - pages are server-rendered (Shopify-based) with the full product-count badge and pagination text plus a subcategory chip-nav strip present in the raw HTML; no Playwright/Chrome escalation was needed. One transient 500 on /esterni-coprisedia/ cleared on a single retry (no repeated-block pattern), so this was not treated as a site block. TREE: built as the union of sitemap-categories.xml (fetched via requests; 594 category URLs) and each visited hub page's own 'plp-category-chips' subcategory strip; h1 and breadcrumb JSON-LD were checked against the requested slug on every leaf recorded - all matched. QTY: taken from the '<N> Prodotti' badge at the top of the grid, cross-checked against the 'Visualizzazione di X su <N> prodotti' pagination-total text at the bottom - both matched on every page sampled. DUPLICATE SLUGS: this is the same Shopify platform as the sister site westwing.co.uk (SR91) and shows the identical near-duplicate-slug pattern - many Furniture-hub category slugs have a second '-2/-3/-4/-5' suffixed twin reached only via the 'Mobili e accessori contenitori' (Storage) hub's own chip nav (e.g. /scaffali/ vs /scaffali-2/, /cassettiere/ vs /cassettiere-3/, /armadi/ vs /armadi-2/, /guardaroba/ vs /guardaroba-2/ which itself renders as 'Appendiabiti'). For every such pair, only the instance reached via the semantically-matching hub was kept (the Storage-hub '-N' variant for Storage.xlsx rows, the Textile-hub '-3' variant for the Kids Textiles baby-product rows reached via tessili-bambini). One true content duplicate was found and collapsed: /cuscini-estivi/ and /cuscini-estivi-2/ are byte-identical listings (same h1 'Cuscini estivi', same qty 302) - only the base slug was kept. Similarly /portatovaglioli/ (napkin holder) and /sottobicchieri/ (coasters) were seen under a Kitchen&Dining-side duplicate hub 'biancheria-da-tavola-e-tessile' (with its own -2 slug twins of the table-linen categories) and excluded as neither textile nor storage. CLASSIFICATION NOTES - TEXTILE: standard bedding/cushion/curtain/rug/bath/kitchen/kids/Christmas textile groups included per textile.md; the Rugs group was broken out by the site's own Material and Shape facet hubs (tappeti-per-materiale, tappeti-per-forma) since those facet pages are themselves real navigational category pages with distinct h1/qty values (not filter checkboxes) - the Room, Colour, Pattern and Pile-Height rug facets were left out as pure cross-cutting attribute filters that return the parent's full 780-item count rather than a distinct qty (confirmed by fetching /tappeti-per-materiale/ and /tappeti-per-forma/, both of which reported qty=780, the same as the parent /tappeti/ page, before drilling into their own child leaf pages which do carry distinct counts). 'Cuscini da pavimento e pouf' (/cuscini-da-pavimento/) and 'Poltrone sacco e cuscini da pavimento' (/poltrone-sacco-e-cuscini-pavimento/) were EXCLUDED from both arrays: both listing titles explicitly co-mingle floor cushions (textile) with poufs/bean-bag chairs (Furniture) under one URL/qty with no way to isolate the textile-only subset, so per the core classification principle (primary product type over a mixed listing name) they were left out rather than guessed. 'Materassini per fasciatoio' (changing pad, 47) was excluded from both arrays - it is nursery equipment (a small mattress), not a textile or storage/organizer product. 'Ceste portabiancheria' (laundry baskets/bags, 58) was excluded from Textile and placed only in Storage per storage.md S25/textile.md S22 (laundry baskets are Storage even though 'biancheria' means linen). 'Portafrutta e portapane' (bread/fruit baskets, 23) and 'Portatovaglioli' (napkin holder/ring, 41) were excluded from both arrays - Kitchen&Dining serving/tableware accessories, not textile and not organizational storage per storage.md S26. CLASSIFICATION NOTES - STORAGE: the 'Mobili e accessori contenitori' hub tree covers Cabinets, Shelving, Wardrobes, Racks/Coat storage, 'Mobili con contenitore' (Furniture with an integrated storage compartment - beds/benches/coffee tables, flagged LOW/MANUAL REVIEW per storage.md S21/S42 since these are primarily Furniture product types), and Small Storage & Organizers; 'Ceste e contenitori cameretta' (Kids Storage) is reached via the Kids/'bambini' mega-menu branch instead but was included per the same storage.md S32 rule. 'Porta carta igienica' (toilet paper holder, 39) was EXCLUDED - a bathroom fixture/hardware item (holds one specific roll), not a general storage/organizer product, analogous to the storage.md S14/S28 bathroom-fixture exclusions. 'Portariviste' (magazine racks, 31) and 'Portasciugamani' (towel racks, 36) were included per storage.md S19 (Racks) as standalone leaves. No company-wide block encountered; status=ok for the full run.
